Send Freeform Message.description: Send a freeform text message (within the 24-hour customer service window only).

Send Media Message.description: Send a media message (document, image, video, or audio) within the 24-hour window.

Send Template Message.description: Send an approved template message. Templates can start a conversation outside the 24-hour window.

Create QR Code Deep Link.description: Create a QR code and wa.me deep link that opens a chat with a prefilled message.

Block User.description: Block a WhatsApp user from messaging this business number.

Update Business Profile.description: Update the business profile shown to WhatsApp users.

Enable Cart and Catalog.description: Turn on the shopping cart and show the product catalog for this number.

Get Phone Number Status.description: Read the quality rating and verified name of the business phone number.

Get Business Profile.description: Read the business profile of the configured phone number.

List Blocked Users.description: List the users blocked from messaging this business number.
List Blocked Users.code:
request('GET', 'block_users');
// state.data.data is an array of { messaging_product, wa_id }.

List QR Code Deep Links.description: List the QR codes and deep links created for this number.
List QR Code Deep Links.code:
request('GET', 'message_qrdls');
// Each item has code, prefilled_message and deep_link_url.
